business_summary: Sekisui House Reit, Inc. is an investment corporation investing primarily in commercial properties including office buildings, hotels and retail and other properties, sponsored by Sekisui House, Ltd., a leading homebuilder representing Japan with an established development and management track record also in the property development business. SHR was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc on December 3, 2014 (securities code: 3309). Sekisui House Residential Investment Corporation was established on April 20, 2005, as an investment corporation investing primarily in residences and retail properties, with the corporate name of JOINT REIT Investment Corporation, and listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on July 28, 2005. In March 2010, a collaboration system was established with Sekisui House serving as the main sponsor and Spring Investment Co., Ltd. as joint sponsor for the investment corporation, which was renamed from JOINT REIT Investment Corporation to Sekisui House SI Investment Corporation in June 2010. Later, in June 2014, its Articles of Incorporation were revised to set residences as the sole target of investment, and the corporate name was changed to Sekisui House SI Residential Investment Corporation. Subsequently, in association with the shift to a structure in which Sekisui House serves as the sole sponsor in March 2017, SHI was renamed to Sekisui House Residential Investment Corporation in June 2017. The Two Investment Corporations, each under the support of the Sekisui House Group had separately conducted asset management to expand their assets and secure stable returns by utilizing their respective strengths with the aim of continuous enhancement of unitholder value. However, intending to secure strong returns and stability and growth of cash distributions through promoting a steady increase of assets under management and endeavor to maximize unitholder value by further expanding the scale of their assets and increasing their market presence and expanding a variety of opportunities for growth through utilizing the integrated corporate strength of the Sekisui House Group, the Two Investment Corporations conducted an absorption-type merger with SHR as the surviving corporation and SHI as the dissolving corporation, setting May 1, 2018 as the effective date. SHR's investment policy is to conduct asset management that seeks to secure stable earnings over the medium to long term and steady growth of its investment assets, with residential properties and commercial properties as major investment targets. Furthermore, by acquiring urban rental housing in the U.S. developed by Sekisui House, SHR has determined that this will contribute to maximizing unitholder value by incorporating "proactive growth" from overseas (U.S.) in addition to "stable growth" in Japan. Thus, during the fiscal period under review, SHR acquired one overseas residential property through the investment in two LLCs located in the U.S. that own overseas real estate. Sekisui House Reit Inc. was established on September 8, 2014 and incorporated in 2014 in Japan.
business_summary_ko: Sekisui House Reit, Inc.는 사무실 건물, 호텔, 소매점 등 상업용 부동산과 기타 자산에 주로 투자하는 투자 회사로, 부동산 개발 사업에서도 확고한 개발 및 관리 실적을 보유한 일본을 대표하는 선도적인 주택 건설업체인 Sekisui House, Ltd.의 후원을 받고 있습니다. SHR은 2014년 12월 3일에 도쿄 증권 거래소 부동산 투자 신탁 부문에 상장되었습니다(증권 코드: 3309). 세키스이하우스 주택투자공사(Sekisui House Residential Investment Corporation)는 2005년 4월 20일 JOINT REIT Investment Corporation이라는 법인명으로 주택 및 리테일 부동산에 주로 투자하는 투자법인으로 설립되어 2005년 7월 28일 도쿄증권거래소 부동산투자신탁 부문에 상장되었습니다. 2010년 3월에는 세키스이하우스를 메인 스폰서로, 스프링인베스트먼트(주)를 공동스폰서로 하는 투자법인의 공동스폰서와 협력 체제를 구축했습니다. 2010년 6월 JOINT REIT 투자 주식회사에서 세키스이 하우스 SI 투자 주식회사로 사명을 변경했습니다. 이후 2014년 6월 정관을 개정하여 주택을 주택으로 설정했습니다.
